description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the lands in Karasnagala, Atthanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Bellanwila, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District and Kalubowila, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: The gazette content primarily deals with the acquisition of immovable property (land) for specific water supply and drainage projects. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels, including their boundaries, locations, and claimants, under the authority of the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act. This fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisition and property matters, not government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
